title: Joint Client-and-Sample Selection for Federated Learning via Bi-level Optimization
motivation: FL中数据样本重要性差异大，且噪声样本与hard样本均有大loss，现有方法无法区分
problem_framing: 将客户端-样本联合选择问题建模为双层优化，外层学选择概率，内层建全局模型
key_insight: 为处理噪声需优先小loss样本，但为识别正影响样本需优先大loss样本，二者冲突构成核心难题
method_signature: 基于元学习的双层FL优化框架，通过梯度操控实现类级别权重学习与隐私保护
evaluation_criteria: 测试准确率提升、计算/通信成本降低、收敛率分析
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Shapley值方法计算代价过高无法规模化；统计阈值方法缺乏先验知识；前作FedCSS实例级权重丢弃了类级信息
evidence_for_taste: to mitigate noisy labels, models often favor samples with small training losses
Conversely, when attempting to identify positively influential samples, models prioritize those with high training losses
This is because to mitigate noisy labels, models often favor samples with small training losses as they are more likely to be clean data
FedCSS alleviates label noise by down-weighting all the gradient flows of the instance while discarding three kinds of information simultaneously
down-weighting the 'not bird' gradient flow is a waste of information
thinking_moves: 将看似相似的两类样本（大loss噪声 vs 大loss hard）的冲突目标显式化
通过双层优化框架将互相冲突的两个子目标统一建模
通过梯度操控把实例级权重推广到类级别以保留细粒度信息
用一阶近似替代二阶Hessian计算以降低计算开销
层次化分析：先选正影响客户端，再分析其样本以节省计算资源
